projects.name: FitShare-Life App
projects.extendedName: An app to manage your workouts like a pro
projects.description: A Full Stack social fitness platform designed to track workouts, visualize progress metrics (PRs), and connect with friends for competition. Built with secure authentication and a real-time database using Supabase, wrapped in a modern UI with Next.js and Tailwind CSS

projects.name: Notes App
projects.extendedName: Keep all your though organized, and your ideas alive
projects.description: A simple web application that allows users to create, edit, delete, archive, and filter notes. This project is implemented as a Single Page Application (SPA) with a REST API backend.

education.title: Bachelor of Science in Software Development
education.description: Earned a Bachelor of Science in Software Development from BYU-Idaho. This comprehensive program provided a strong foundation in software engineering principles, data structures, and the lifecycle of building scalable applications.
